calibration.interpretation: ECE is high because P(omega) measures EVIDENCE QUALITY, not P(safe). Subtle failures (F3, F4, F6) produce high P(omega) because the available evidence looks clean. This is correct: the score reflects what the evidence says. Detection of these subtle failures relies on per-dimension monitoring, not the aggregate score.
